steps.note: S1.3 asserts that the network restores scratch wires for arbitrary initial values (quoting the lemma statement at 729) but never derives that the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of the scratch values because the last rows restore them.
The plan never gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side cancellation of intersection-one cases, or the self coefficient one.
The complex-case coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side cancellation of intersections zero and two do not appear; S1.5.1 gives the form <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 but not the motif coefficients.
S1.3 states three stages and the end result (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) but not the stage-by-stage states (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x).
S1.5.2 says every edge joins comparable labels, but no per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions are given.
The side edge 2->5 argument (t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> in t_Y^perp, complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2) is not stated; S1.5.1 only notes that neighboring triple lines are orthogonal.

S1.5.2 names the only decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), the gate-telescoping reason and the final Wm-2N+2L, but omits the source sum N, sink sum Wm-N and signed total Wm-2N that the telescoping produces, so the absolute total is asserted rather than derived (borderline, marked absent).
S2.1.1 uses an orthonormal basis of each residual but never says why one exists (nondegenerate and nonalternating over F_2, absorbing alternating planes).
S1.5.3 gives L_b/N=100/539 but the complex ratio L_c/N=101/539 appears nowhere, so only half of the defining content is stated.

The S2.1 method uses additivity of Hamming weight modulo four over orthogonal vectors to factor each phase-frame change into one kernel per vector of an orthonormal residual basis (S2.1.1), a faithful paraphrase of q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x].
The kernel aI+bX_v is named, but the odd weight of v, the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, and the conjugation H diag(1,-1) H = X that turns it into a translation are not stated.
S2.1.2 and S2.1.3 state that each residual basis vector gives one child factor on its slot of f axes (columns), and summing residual dimensions gives exactly s_c such factors.

The plan mentions only 'Z conjugations and fourth-root phases' and 'endpoint corrections'; it does not give the zero/full label frames I and C^{tensor m}, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, the repair Z_{a,k} / i^{27k}Z_{a,k} via C=iZC^{-1}Z, or the negated X outputs.
S1.5.3 gives L_b/N=100/539<1/2, S1.5.4 the deficit N-2L_b>0, and S1.5 s_b<W_b m (stated for the bit network).
The exact value eta_b=339/22587335000000 is not given; S1.5.5 refers to the relative deficit only qualitatively.
eta_c=73/19906842167500 does not appear in the plan.

S1.5.5 and S1.6.4.1 state that the deficit exceeds 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} (written out for the bit network; the same mechanism as the paper).

S1.6.1.1 asserts A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones (citing Bruhat) but does not give the elimination proof (pivot at the topmost row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on the active indices).
The choice of a fixed odd prime that avoids all denominators in the finite factor table, so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors, is not stated.

S1.6.1 says controlled shifts update a later field from earlier ones in linear time, so triangular changes are cheap, but it omits the descending physical update order that keeps the earlier coordinates at their original values (marked absent because unsure).
S1.6.1.2 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, giving (h+d,d) with one interchange per one of Pi, a in all.
S2.5 gives only Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20); the constants E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are not defined.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound 8e and the per-invocation count below E do not appear; S2.5 just asserts depth at most Delta.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu to A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are absent.

S2.5 states the p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer reservation and Delta=o(p), but not that depth l means values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l, and it does not tie eps C_1<1 to Delta=o(p), so the result is asserted without its mechanism.
S2.6 states that each row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P06 states 6 of the 26 sub-steps (P1, P3, R1, R4, M4, S5). It mostly asserts lemma-level results, such as the bank exchange, the residual budget, the Bruhat factorization and the guard width, without the paper's internal derivations. The residual table, the endpoint phase repairs, the exact eta values and the whole depth recurrence for the simultaneous layer are missing. L3, M3 and S4 are partial: each states part of the mechanism and was marked absent.
